en: More beasts on the way!
The lunar celebration this year is quite magnificent!
Can that be The Razza down there in the Maul?  This is going to be exciting!
Teach me the ways of the spirits.

The Ahn'Qiraj War is on the horizon, $c, and in preparation the Alliance has asked my family to gather up a good deal of light leather for the war effort. Out of $2061w needed, we currently have $2060w. You look the type that might be able to help out.
Uldaman can be found at the very northern end of the Badlands.
Here are the orders, $n.  Now, take them quickly to Field Marshal Teravaine!
Kill them all!
I perform one final service. I pray it is sufficient...
Hold on there, I'm just an assistant. If ye want to start learnin' the fancy stuff, talk to old Stonebrew over there.
I don't get paid enough for this bull excrement!
$n, underneath the moss, this heart looks like a seed!

I would speak against my brother joining the order, rushing a permanent breech in our relationship.  He would be a danger to himself and those around him, and that is too great a risk hoping he would improve over time.
Assassins from that cult you found... Let's get moving before someone else finds us out here.
Losing my life was a danger I had come to terms with.  Losing Ysida is something I cannot endure, even after my own death.
Mage
I have lost my Gavel of Infinite Wisdom. Are you able to replace it for me?
Burning Steppes - Tablet of the Seven
Indeed, Silverwing Hold is in need of your assistance. Speak with Elfarran in the audience chamber at Stormwind Keep.
Some people think the swamp's no good... no good, they say.
The bastion is falling! Burn the evidence!
Do as I taught you!

Have you heard the good news, $c? The Alliance has completed all of its war effort collections! Now we simply await the Horde to finish theirs. When they do, we'll begin shipping all of the war materiel over to Silithus, and it shouldn't be long after that until the Ahn'Qiraj War begins.
Masters, I pledge this $r to you!
Yes, Torta. Whatever your heart desires...
Anyway, I should probably get back to work. Speaking of, do you have any food or valuables that I could lift off of you? Maybe some windstones? Could always use more windstones?
Progeny of Aegwynn, he that would be the last Guardian of Tirisfal... Medivh.
Go, my servant.  Send word of Stonetalon to Apothecary Zamah.
My entrails are leaking out! HELP!
Greetings, friend!  Can I interest you in some ectoplasmic capacitors?  Or perhaps a nice omni-directional spectral assimilator?
Well, well... look what the cat brung in... and how can I help you, $c?
Duke of Cynders! I hold your signet!  Heed my call!
Why is it that small creatures such as goblins are always fascinated with larger creatures?
I sense a great power among us, Commander. Is the spell ready?
The Iceblood Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will capture it!
Be gone, infidel!  May the power of the Abyss smite you down!
You're going to pay for this outrage! Guards!
But... Malfurion, Cenarius, Ysera... they still fight. They need me. I must return to the Dream at once.

Hello once again, $n.  I sense that the flow of time remains threatened by forces that are quite powerful indeed.  Your continued assistance is always welcomed by the bronze dragonflight.$B$BWhile the past is set in its ways, the future is always changing.  The decisions you make in the here and now help guide that change.
